messages.author: 5d9ca4aba820f1f5
messages.subject: Crashes in RStudio
parts:
Hi,

if I try use runModels on my machine (OS X 10.8.2), Rstudio crashes. It works fine
from the R console. I found that this could be fixed by not calling "cd" in the 
"system"-call but using complete paths to tell Mplus where file is instead.

Best,

Ruben

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Crashes in RStudio
parts:
Hi Ruben,

Is there any chance you can narrow the bug down? For example does
Rstudio crash when you issue a system command with cd?

Apologies if you have already tried these, but as they are usual
suspects: are you running the latest version of R (2.15.2 or 2.3.0)
and the latest version of Rstudio (v0.97.318)?

I do not think that that system command should be an issue, which is
supported by the fact that it works from the R console. One issue I
have had before with system calls, is that some editors customize the
shell used by R---this may explain some discrepancies.

Best,

Josh
